name: HCA Hierarchy Consumer A
brief: Level-2 consumer: depends on the shared library only. Both other consumers depend on THIS app sideways.
description: The middle of the hierarchy. Depends on HSL Hierarchy Shared Lib, and is itself depended on by HCB Hierarchy Consumer B and HCC Hierarchy Consumer C — the sideways edges between co-dependents of one shared library that no other fixture in this bundle has. Contributes: a Contribute() that calls into the shared library (so a caller two levels above reaches the library through this app), a broadcast subscriber, a tableextension on the SHARED LIBRARY's table, and an enumextension on the shared library's enum. See HTS Hierarchy Tests.
